narration.en: Some plants make seeds without any fertilisation. Farmers would love this, because the hybrid character would never be lost.
narration.kn: ಕೆಲವು ಸಸ್ಯಗಳು ನಿಷೇಚನವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಬೀಜಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಸಂಕರ ಗುಣ ಕಳೆದುಹೋಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

body.en: Apomixis is the formation of seeds without fertilisation; it is a form of asexual reproduction that mimics sexual reproduction. It is common in Asteraceae and grasses. A diploid egg may form without reduction division and develop into an embryo, or cells of the nucellus may develop directly into embryos. Hybrid seeds must be bought every year because the F1 traits segregate in the next generation; if hybrids were made apomictic, farmers could keep using their own seed.
body.kn: ಅಸಂಯೋಗಜನನ ಎಂದರೆ ನಿಷೇಚನವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಬೀಜ ಉಂಟಾಗುವುದು. ಇದು ಆಸ್ಟರೇಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹುಲ್ಲುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ. ಸಂಕರ ತಳಿಗಳನ್ನು ಅಸಂಯೋಗಜನಕವಾಗಿಸಿದರೆ ರೈತರು ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಬೀಜ ಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ.

narration.en: Hybrid seed gives high yields because the F1 plants are heterozygous, but if a farmer sows seed saved from them, the characters segregate and heterozygosity halves with each generation of selfing, so yield falls and new hybrid seed must be bought every year. If the hybrid could make seed by apomixis (without fertilisation), the seed would be a clone and keep the hybrid vigour. Yield here is a simple model.
narration.kn: ಸಂಕರ ಬೀಜ F1 ಸಸ್ಯಗಳು ವಿಷಮಯುಗ್ಮಜಗಳಾಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇಳುವರಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದರೆ ಅವುಗಳಿಂದ ಉಳಿಸಿದ ಬೀಜ ಬಿತ್ತಿದರೆ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕಗೊಂಡು ಪ್ರತಿ ತಲೆಮಾರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಷಮಯುಗ್ಮತೆ ಅರ್ಧವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಇಳುವರಿ ಕುಸಿಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಹೊಸ ಬೀಜ ಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. ಸಂಕರ ಅಸಂಯೋಗಜನನದಿಂದ (ನಿಷೇಚನವಿಲ್ಲದೆ) ಬೀಜ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಅದು ತದ್ರೂಪಿಯಾಗಿ ಸಂಕರ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

Hybrid seed must be bought every year because the F1 segregates in the next generation. An apomictic hybrid would breed true, so farmers could keep their own seed.

say.en: Polyembryony means more than one embryo in a seed. In Citrus and mango, nucellus cells around the embryo sac grow into extra embryos.
The nucellar embryos come from the mother plant's own diploid cells, so they are genetically identical to her: natural clones.

explanation.en: Apomixis forms seeds without fertilisation (Asteraceae, grasses). Polyembryony means more than one embryo per seed, as nucellar embryos in Citrus and mango. Parthenocarpic fruits like banana have no seeds. Hybrid seed must be bought each year because F1 traits segregate. Perisperm is persistent nucellus (black pepper, beet).
explanation.kn: ಅಪೊಮಿಕ್ಸಿಸ್, ಬಹುಭ್ರೂಣತೆ, ಅನಿಷೇಕ ಫಲ, ಸಂಕರ ಬೀಜ ಮತ್ತು ಪೆರಿಸ್ಪರ್ಮ್.

body.en: Polyembryony is the occurrence of more than one embryo in a seed. In many Citrus and mango varieties some nucellar cells around the embryo sac divide and grow into extra embryos. These nucellar embryos are genetically identical to the mother plant, so they behave like clones.
body.kn: ಒಂದು ಬೀಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಭ್ರೂಣಗಳಿರುವುದು ಬಹುಭ್ರೂಣತೆ. ನಿಂಬೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನ್ಯೂಸೆಲ್ಲಸ್ ಕೋಶಗಳಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಭ್ರೂಣಗಳು ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: A farmer grows an F1 hybrid maize that yields very well. He sows seeds saved from this crop the next year and the yield falls. Explain, and say how apomixis could help.

steps.en: The F1 hybrid is heterozygous for many genes.
When it is sexually reproduced, the genes segregate in the F2, so the plants are not uniform and lose hybrid vigour.
If the hybrid were apomictic, seeds would form without meiosis and fertilisation, so the progeny would be identical to the F1.

answer.en: Segregation in F2 lowers yield; apomictic hybrids would breed true, so the farmer could save seed
